relay_on_latency_ms.description: Delay from relay command energised to contacts closed.

relay_off_latency_ms.description: Delay from relay command released to contacts open.

motor_tau_up_s.description: First-order spin-up time constant while the motor is powered.

motor_tau_down_s.description: First-order coast-down time constant after power-off (burrs keep grinding while coasting).

motor_stall_tau_s.description: Speed decay time constant while the MOTOR_STALL fault is active.

motor_min_speed.description: Normalised speed below which the burrs produce no grounds (tuned so the shortest productive pulse is about 42-46 ms, cf. src/config/debug.h:45).

flow_nominal_gps.description: Burr output at full speed with a full chamber: the firmware's own mock flow rate. Sweep range is the firmware's sane flow window, src/config/grind_control.h:78-79.

grind_setting_factor.description: Relative flow for the burr gap (coarser > 1, finer < 1); multiplies the nominal flow.

bean_factor.description: Relative flow for bean hardness/roast; multiplies the nominal flow.

flow_noise_frac.description: Standard deviation of the multiplicative flow noise (fraction of flow).

flow_noise_tau_s.description: Correlation time of the low-pass filtered flow noise.

clump_rate_hz.description: Poisson rate of clump releases at full speed and full chamber. Mean flow is kept at nominal.

clump_mass_g.description: Mean mass of a clump released at once (exponentially distributed).

burr_taper_mass_g.description: Chamber mass below which flow tapers linearly towards zero.

burr_residual_g.description: Mass that stays in the burr chamber and is never ground (flow reaches zero here: run-dry).

burr_capacity_g.description: Burr chamber capacity; a single 18 g dose fits entirely inside.

feed_rate_gps.description: Maximum rate at which beans fall from the hopper into free chamber space.

chute_retention_g.description: Static retention capacity of the chute: grounds up to this mass stay until pushed out.

chute_tau_s.description: Time constant with which grounds above the retention capacity drain out of the chute.

transport_delay_s.description: Fixed fall/transport delay from chute exit to the cup. Hard cap 1.0 s (ring buffer of 1000 one-ms bins).

drop_height_m.description: Free-fall height of grounds from chute exit to the cup; sets the stream impact force flow*sqrt(2*g*h)/g.

cup_mass_g.description: Default empty cup mass used by PLACE_CUP when no value is given.

lc_counts_per_g.description: HX711 counts per gram (negative: more mass gives a lower code). Default equals the firmware default calibration factor; the sweep (+-5 %) is a placeholder for sensitivity mismatch.

lc_baseline_code.description: Signed HX711 code of the empty platform. The mock's offset-binary 0x700000 equals signed 0x700000^0x800000 = -1048576. Sweep range is a placeholder.

lc_gain_error.description: Fractional gain error between true grams and counts (true sensitivity = lc_counts_per_g*(1+error)).

lc_idle_noise_counts.description: Peak of the uniform per-conversion ADC noise when idle, as in the firmware mock.

lc_vibration_noise_counts.description: Peak per-conversion noise from motor vibration at full speed (scales with motor speed).

lc_natural_freq_hz.description: Natural frequency of the platform/load cell second-order response.

lc_damping.description: Damping ratio of the platform/load cell response (lightly damped < 1).

lc_creep_frac.description: Fraction of a load change that arrives slowly (creep).

lc_creep_tau_s.description: Time constant of the creep fraction.

lc_drift_g_per_min.description: Deterministic linear zero drift of the sensed mass.

lc_drift_walk_g_per_rtmin.description: Random-walk zero drift intensity (standard deviation after 1 min is this value).

lc_place_impact_frac.description: Peak of the cup placement impact transient as a fraction of the placed mass.

lc_impact_tau_s.description: Decay time constant of placement and bump transients.

hx711_sps.description: Output data rate: 10 (RATE pin low, the firmware setting) or 80 (RATE pin high, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md:113). Any value in 1..1000 is accepted and only changes the conversion period.

hx711_settle_ms_10sps.description: Output settling time after power-up at 10 SPS (recollection of the HX711 datasheet, unverified offline).

hx711_settle_ms_80sps.description: Output settling time after power-up at 80 SPS (recollection of the HX711 datasheet, unverified offline).
